title: Smoky Lamb Kebabs with Egyptian Flair
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb kebab dish inspired by Egyptian cuisine, marinated in a blend of spices and herbs.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb slices to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
